entries.0cb5a2a5caaab8fe: A region where local subsidiaries in the United States, Canada and Mexico manufacture and sell automotive body press parts and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,657 million (up 1.1% year on year), the largest region within total company revenue of ¥333,413 million.
